paragraphs: PowerDMS by NEOGOV sells a public safety management system that brings policy, training, scheduling and compliance workflows onto one platform. Separate modules cover policy management, accreditation management, internal affairs, early intervention, field training, off duty scheduling, background investigations and text messaging surveys. The solution list carries both a public safety version and a healthcare version of policy management and of accreditation management.

Buyers named on the site include sworn officers, command staff and first responders who must meet state and federal reporting mandates. Named customers include the Lake Worth Police Department, the Cleveland Police Department and the Boulder Police Department. Testimonials also come from a county sheriff's office, a county communications center and a state law enforcement division.

Pricing is an annual subscription tailored to agency size, product selection and integrations. The software is cloud-based and requires no servers or maintenance. The site states that over 5,500 agencies use PowerDMS by NEOGOV.

quote.text: PowerDMS is a complete public safety management system, built with AI for public safety to bring critical workflows into one platform, helping agencies operate more efficiently and make better decisions.
